title: Backend Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Backend Engineer** 
 to build the services and systems that power visa processing for travellers around the world, from the APIs behind our apps to the pipelines that file every application.
   

  

 You'll design and own Python services that connect government portals, payment providers, document pipelines and our AI systems, and keep them fast, reliable and correct as we scale across countries and volume.
   

  

 This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves clean systems design, and who gets as much satisfaction from a service that quietly works at peak load as from shipping a new feature.
   

  

**The Job**
* Build the core platform by designing and shipping Python services and APIs that power applications, payments, document handling and order tracking across 127 countries.
* Integrate with the real world by building robust integrations with government portals, embassies, payment gateways and partners, handling retries, rate limits, flaky endpoints and ever\-changing rules gracefully.
* Scale for volume by designing data models, queues and async workflows that hold up through peak travel seasons and sudden spikes in demand.
* Put AI into production by working closely with our AI team to turn LLM\-powered agents and document intelligence pipelines into reliable, observable backend services.
* Own systems end to end by taking work from design to production, including deployment, monitoring, alerting and incident follow\-ups, with a high bar for testing and security since we handle passports and financial documents.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 2\-5 years of backend engineering experience, building and running production systems at meaningful scale.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and have shipped production services with frameworks such as FastAPI, Django or Flask.
* Have solid fundamentals in databases and distributed systems, including PostgreSQL, Redis, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS or Celery), caching and async processing.
* Are comfortable with cloud infrastructure and modern tooling such as AWS or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability stacks.
* Have exposure to browser automation (Playwright, Selenium), integrating LLM APIs, or building in fintech, travel or other high\-compliance domains (a strong plus).


**Here's What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.
   

  

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

title: Backend Developer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job About us: Dynasoft Applied Systems Private Limited is part of a Dubai based venture having its offices in multiple locations including Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Bahrain, Sharjah, Bangalore, Maharashtra, New Delhi and Gurgaon. It is a software arm of the entire group focused on cutting edge innovative software solutions around Fintech, Social Tech and Defense Tech. As a group, we operate across multiple business verticals including construction and real estate, hospitality, fintech, defense technologies, communication and signaling protocol, logistics, solar and manufacturing of specialized equipment. The group is expanding its India operations and we are seeking highly motivated, young and skilled professionals to join our teams. Location: Dubai/Gurugram Experience: 4\-6 years Position Summary: We are looking for a Backend Developer who is strong in both Java and Python to design, build, and maintain scalable backend services for modern web, mobile, operational, and integration\-driven platforms. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with Java/Spring Boot for production backend systems, and practical Python experience for APIs, services, automation, integrations, data workflows, and backend tooling. This role is suited for a hands\-on engineer who can take ownership of APIs, database design, service architecture, integrations, performance, security, testing, documentation, and production support. The person should be comfortable working across existing systems as well as building new backend components in the right technology for the problem. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and Python. Build secure, scalable, and well\-documented REST APIs for web, mobile, admin, operational, and third\-party integration use cases. Develop Python\-based backend services, automation scripts, integration adapters, reporting jobs, internal tools, and data\-processing workflows where required. Design and maintain PostgreSQL database schemas, migrations, indexes, constraints, optimized queries, and data integrity rules. Implement reliable service\-layer logic, validation, error handling, pagination, filtering, idempotency, transaction management, and background processing. Work with event\-driven patterns using Kafka, message queues, or similar platforms for asynchronous workflows, notifications, telemetry, analytics, and integration events. Use Redis or equivalent caching/session layers to improve performance, reduce database load, and support fast backend workflows. Integrate with external systems such as payment gateways, notification providers, reporting tools, CRM/ERP systems, cloud services, and other third\-party platforms as required. Implement authentication, authorization, RBAC, audit logging, input validation, secure API patterns, and safe handling of sensitive data. Write clean, maintainable, testable code and participate in code reviews across Java and Python codebases. Create and maintain unit tests, integration tests, API tests, technical documentation, and developer handover notes. Support production deployments, monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, incident investigation, performance optimization, and operational reliability. Collaborate with frontend, mobile, DevOps, QA, product, and business teams to translate requirements into reliable backend solutions. Mentor junior developers where required and help improve backend engineering standards across the team. Required Skills and Experience 4 to 6 years of backend development experience, with strong hands\-on experience in Java/Spring Boot and practical experience with Python backend development, automation, integrations, scripting, or data workflows. Stronger candidates with 6\+ years of senior\-level backend experience may also be considered. Strong practical Python experience, preferably with FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar backend/API frameworks. Strong understanding of REST API design, API versioning, authentication, authorization, error contracts, pagination, documentation, and OpenAPI/Swagger or similar tools. Strong PostgreSQL experience, including schema design, joins, indexes, transactions, query optimization, migrations, constraints, and data integrity practices. Practical experience with Kafka, message queues, or event\-driven systems, including producers, consumers, retries, duplicate handling, idempotency, and failure recovery. Good understanding of distributed systems concepts such as eventual consistency, retries, background processing, service boundaries, and failure\-safe workflows. Experience with Redis or similar caching/session technologies. Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, secrets management, and cloud\-ready application deployment. Good understanding of security best practices, including JWT/OAuth2 concepts, RBAC, OWASP API risks, audit trails, and secure handling of sensitive data. Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across application logs, APIs, databases, queues, background workers, and production environments. Ability to write clean code, structure services properly, document decisions, review code, and communicate technical trade\-offs clearly. Comfortable working in both existing systems and new development, without overengineering or rewriting unnecessarily. Preferred Skills Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS, RDS, managed Kafka, ElastiCache, S3, CloudWatch, or similar cloud services. Experience with Python background workers or task queues such as Celery, RQ, Dramatiq, APScheduler, or similar tools. Experience with microservices, modular monoliths, domain\-driven design, service\-oriented architecture, or backend platform modernization. Experience with payment webhooks, order workflows, workflow engines, analytics pipelines, reporting systems, data ingestion, or operational dashboards. Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, New Relic, or similar tools. Experience with Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, Testcontainers, Pytest, Kafka Streams, Debezium, outbox pattern, or CDC patterns. Experience integrating AI/ML APIs, OCR, document processing, workflow automation, or internal productivity tools using Python is a plus. Ability to mentor developers and support engineering standards across multiple backend technologies. Candidate Profile Hands\-on backend engineer with strong ownership and accountability. Comfortable using Java/Spring Boot for robust production services and Python for fast, reliable backend services, integrations, automations, and tooling. Able to think beyond simple CRUD APIs and design systems for reliability, security, scalability, and maintainability. Strong problem\-solver who can debug real production issues and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical teams. Organized, documentation\-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast\-moving product environment. Practical and delivery\-focused: understands when to build, when to refactor, when to stabilize, and when to keep the solution simple. How to Apply Interested candidates may share their CV, portfolio/GitHub profile if available, notice period, expected compensation, and a brief summary of relevant Java, Spring Boot, and Python backend experience at \*\* hr@dcsys.xyz\*\*
   

  

**Required Skills**
 \['Python Java MongoDB PostgreSQL AWS Spring Boot Linxus FastAPI']
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 NA

title: IAM Development Engineer
description:
**Role and impact**
 As an
 **IAM Development Engineer at Topsoe** 
 , you will help design, develop, and maintain the integrations and platform functionality that support secure, reliable identity and access management across the organization.
   

  

 You will work with
 **SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC)** 
 and a wide range of enterprise applications to enable seamless application onboarding and robust identity lifecycle processes. From analysis and design to testing, deployment, rollback, and stabilization, you will help deliver solutions that are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with Topsoe’s IAM architecture.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop and maintain IAM connectors for enterprise applications, including SAP and other connected systems.
* Configure SailPoint ISC functionality and implement provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
* Support joiner, mover, and leaver processes, access requests, access reviews, and role\-based access models.
* Support application onboarding by analyzing requirements, identity data, roles, and entitlements.
* Perform technical testing and support deployment, rollback, troubleshooting, and stabilization activities.
* Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge\-transfer activities.
* Improve development processes, integration patterns, and operational practices.


**What You Will Bring**
 You have a strong background in integration and development, combined with an understanding of identity provisioning and IAM processes. You are comfortable working in a global corporate environment and collaborating with technical teams, application owners, and stakeholders.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Experience With**
* REST APIs, JSON, XML, and SCIM.
* OAuth2, client credentials, certificates, tokens, and other authentication methods.
* Java, JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting and development languages.
* Git and version control systems.
* Debugging, log analysis, and technical troubleshooting.
* Identity provisioning, application integrations, and lifecycle processes.
* Clear communication, structured problem\-solving, and effective documentation.
* Experience is SailPoint (Certification will be an advantage)


**Experience In The Following Areas Would Be An Advantage**
* SailPoint certification and connector development.
* Cloud and Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) integrations.
* CI/CD processes and secure coding practices.
* SAP, Topdesk, Active Directory, or Entra ID.
* SQL\-based applications and enterprise platforms.
* Designing or maintaining role\-based access models.
* Working with global teams and complex system dependencies.


**Why Join Us**
 Joining Topsoe as offers you the unique opportunity to help build and shape our internal Identity and Access Management (IAM) team, working closely with a dedicated group of four professionals. You will play a key role in transferring critical IAM platform knowledge and responsibility from our external partner to the internal team, ensuring a strong foundation for future growth and security. As part of your responsibilities, you will assist with onboarding new applications to the IAM platform, making a tangible impact on our IT landscape. This is a chance to contribute to a collaborative environment, drive innovation, and be at the forefront of Topsoe’s digital transformation.
   

  

**Your New Team**
 You will join a dedicated internal IAM team of four professionals and play an important role in building Topsoe’s future IAM capabilities. Together, you will help transfer critical platform knowledge and responsibilities from our external partner to the internal team.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on Topsoe’s IT landscape while contributing to a collaborative environment focused on security, innovation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Help shape and strengthen Topsoe’s internal IAM function.
* Support the onboarding of new applications to the IAM platform.
* Develop reliable and scalable integration patterns.
* Improve identity lifecycle and access management processes.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and team development.
* Be part of Topsoe’s continued digital transformation.


**How You Can Apply**
 If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
   

  

 Please contact Stefan Schuller via email sslr@topsoe.com if you want to know more about the position.
   

  

**Application deadline: 18\-10\-2026** 
 .
   

  

 You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
   

  

 To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
   

  

 To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.
   

  

**About Us**
 Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
   

  

 Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
   

  

 We offer world\-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low\-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
   

  

 We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
   

  

 Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
   

  

 The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first\-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
   

  

 This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
   

  

**Core areas of impact include:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:** 
 Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first\-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.


**Responsibilities:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:** 
 Monitors live AI workloads, owns first\-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:** 
 Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:** 
 Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:** 
 Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non\-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**Proven Characteristics for Success**
* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data\-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action\-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.


**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**
* Hands\-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self\-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.


**Preferred**
* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.


**Education**
* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self\-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.


**Tii Elements**
* **Curiosity:** 
 Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:** 
 Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:** 
 Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal \& external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self\-Awareness \& Impact:** 
 Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.


  

  

**Additional Information**
  

**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  

 At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
   

  

 In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being.
   

  

**Our Mission** 
 is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
   

  

  

  

**Our Values** 
 underpin everything we do.
   

* **Customer Centric:** 
 Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:** 
 We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:** 
 Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action \& Ownership:** 
 We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:** 
 We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:** 
 We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.


**Global Benefits**
* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self\-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days \+ Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*


 \* varies by country
   

  

**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  

 At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

 In India, we have our teams based in Pune, Mumbai, Delhi and, Bangalore. We pride ourselves on being client\-focused and collaborative, on the pioneering edge of technology. We also have fun. Whether it’s office happy hours, team outings, or game nights, we believe in working with people we like to hang out with.

title: Product Engineer (Field Tools)
description:
****Starting Date:****
 December 2026
   

  

****Contract type:****
 Full\-time and open\-ended
   

  

****Salary:****
 From 2,716,737 INR
   

  

****Location:****
 India; Delhi, Ahmedabad (Hybrid)
   

  

****Application closing date:****
 8th October 2026
   

  

**If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.**
**About The Job**
 The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.
   

  

****The Challenge****
 Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will be responsible for :
   

  

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.
* Partner with the Product Designer to shape simple, effective user flows for mobile, offline, and multilingual field use.
* Translate agreed solutions into clear, prioritised, testable delivery increments, and build high\-quality features across frontend, backend, and data layers.
* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.


**Experience**
 the following skills, knowledge, and experience:
   

  

**Essential**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.


**What We Offer**
* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.


****Working arrangements****
 The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.
   

  

****Apply now****
 Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before
 ****08\.10\.2026****
 via the application link.
   

  

 In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.
   

  

 Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.
   

  

****Our hiring process****
**Initial Screening**
 Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.
   

  

**Interviews**
 If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.
   

  

**Assessment And Testing**
 Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.
   

  

**Reference Checks**
 Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.
   

  

**Offer Stage**
 After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.
   

  

**About Better Cotton Initiative**
 Better Cotton Initiative is a global not\-for\-profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.
   

  

**About Our Values**
 The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:
   

  

* Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
* As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
* Positive (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
* Daring (including courageous, innovative, game\-changing)


****Being you @ Better Cotton****
****Initiative****
 Better Cotton Initiative is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.
   

  

 We have a zero\-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in enabling MongoDB’s post\-sales business processes, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows. By leveraging Salesforce and related business systems, the team ensures that post\-sales teams have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support customer outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and drive long\-term customer growth.
   

  

 With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, integrations, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to support evolving post\-sales business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Customer Success, Technical Services, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Billing, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a highly experienced Lead Salesforce Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and evolution of critical Salesforce and CRM solutions supporting MongoDB’s post\-sales business processes. This role combines deep technical leadership, hands\-on solution design, cross\-functional stakeholder partnership, people management, and a modern engineering mindset that embraces AI\-powered development responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and long\-term platform health.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing scalable Salesforce solutions for complex customer lifecycle processes, including customer success operations, support workflows, renewals, account management, customer health, and post\-sales automation.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable Salesforce solutions supporting post\-sales teams, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows
* Translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions aligned with long\-term platform strategy
* Partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver high\-quality post\-sales solutions
* Oversee integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise platforms, ensuring reliable data flow and sound system design across the customer lifecycle
* Drive platform optimization across performance, scalability, usability, maintainability, and governance

* Maintain technical documentation, including architecture decisions, design specifications, and implementation details
* Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, releases, and best practices, and proactively recommend improvements
* Proactively identify process and technical gaps, and help define and drive tech debt reduction initiatives, platform modernization efforts, and engineering efficiency improvements across the Salesforce ecosystem
* Leverage AI\-powered engineering tools such as Apex Guru, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce/Vibes, Claude Code, and similar capabilities to improve development productivity, code quality, design effectiveness, troubleshooting, and documentation, while applying strong judgment around security, privacy, accuracy, and responsible AI usage


**Responsibilities**

* Act as a subject matter expert on Salesforce development, platform capabilities, automation, integrations, and scalable CRM solution design for post\-sales business processes
* Lead technical design sessions and identify gaps between current\-state and future\-state solutions
* Design and support scalable solutions for customer success, support operations, renewals, customer health, account management, and related post\-sales workflows
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices, and drive proof\-of\-concepts where appropriate
* Mentor engineers across the team and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence
* Support team growth by coaching, developing talent, and helping build a high\-performing engineering organization
* Influence business and technical stakeholders through strong communication, sound judgment, and effective problem\-solving
* Operate effectively in a fast\-changing environment by managing priorities, driving accountability, and ensuring high\-quality execution


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 12\+ years of experience in Salesforce engineering, application development, or technical leadership within global SaaS organizations
* Strong hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, integrations, and Salesforce platform customization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, design patterns, and scalable solution design
* Experience designing or supporting Salesforce solutions for post\-sales functions such as Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, or customer lifecycle management
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, and Agile/Scrum delivery models
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification required; Salesforce Certified Application Architect and Salesforce Certified System Architect certifications strongly preferred


 Success Measures
   

  

 In 3 months, you will
   

  

 Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, post\-sales business processes, and technical landscape. Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Customer Success, Support, Revenue Operations, and Engineering.
   

  

 In 6 months, you will
   

  

 Lead the technical design and successful delivery of critical Salesforce initiatives supporting post\-sales workflows. Establish yourself as a trusted technical leader within the Business Systems team.
   

  

 In 12 months, you will
   

  

 Be the go\-to technical leader for Salesforce architecture, complex solution design, and platform strategy for post\-sales systems. Elevate team quality through strong technical leadership, mentoring, and scalable engineering practices

**Summary**
 Build AI native, enterprise integration products on SAP BTP Integration Suite by combining strong integration engineering fundamentals with agentic AI patterns (LLMs \+ tools \+ retrieval \+ evaluation). The role focuses on creating and operating production\-grade integrations across cloud, on premise, and hybrid landscapes—while augmenting the integration lifecycle with intelligent capabilities such as automated iFlow generation, mapping recommendations, anomaly detection, predictive operations, and conversational troubleshooting. This role owns AI behavior in the integration layer (grounding, safety, evaluation), not just AI\-assisted development.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Integration Engineering (Cloud, Hybrid, On Prem)


 Design, develop, and run end\-to\-end integration scenarios using cloud integration capabilities, enabling reliable connectivity across SAP and non SAP systems.
   

  

 Build, structure, and manage large integration flows with clear modularity, reusability, and maintainability for enterprise scale.
   

  

* Integration Flow Development (iFlows) \& Message Transformation


 Create and maintain integration flows using routing, splitting, gathering, and other transformation patterns.
   

  

 Implement message mappings and data transformations for common enterprise formats (e.g., JSON, XML, CSV), ensuring semantic correctness and downstream compatibility.
   

  

 Apply canonical modeling and contract\-first practices to reduce brittle point\-to\-point dependencies.
   

  

* Scripting, Persistence \& Advanced Flow Control


 Use scripting (e.g., Groovy) to implement complex transformation logic, enrichment, validation, and conditional execution paths.
   

  

 Implement message persistence patterns (e.g., data stores) to support idempotency, retries, correlation, and resilience.
   

  

* API \& Connector Enablement


 Design and expose secure APIs through API management capabilities (policies, authentication/authorization, throttling, versioning).
   

  

 Integrate with third party applications using connector\-based approaches and standardized integration patterns.
   

  

 Enable event\-driven integration approaches using messaging/event capabilities for near real\-time propagation and decoupled architectures.
   

  

* AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer)


 Build integration agents that can generate initial iFlows from system/endpoint selections and naming conventions, then validate them against enterprise standards.
   

  

 Implement retrieval\-grounded assistance that pulls from interface catalogs, mapping specs, standards, runbooks, and known incident patterns to produce verifiable recommendations (no free\-form guessing).
   

  

 Apply intelligent recommendations for mapping and configuration, accelerating build and reducing rework.
   

  

 Develop AI\-driven anomaly detection and prediction for integration/API behavior (error spikes, latency patterns), with human\-in\-the\-loop controls for remediation actions.
   

  

 Optimize and analyze scripts used in integration flows for performance and maintainability through AI\-assisted code analysis techniques.
   

  

* Testing, Quality Engineering \& Evaluation Loops


 Build automated testing strategies for integrations: schema/contract validation, payload regression suites, replay testing, and API testing tool\-driven verification.
   

  

 Implement AI evaluation harnesses (offline golden test sets \+ online monitoring) for generated mappings, generated flows, and operational recommendations.
   

  

 Establish release gates for both integration changes and AI prompt/tool updates to prevent silent degradation.
   

  

* Monitoring, Troubleshooting \& Observability


 Set up monitoring dashboards and alerts for flows, APIs, and event\-driven pipelines establish traceability with correlation IDs and end\-to\-end tracking.
   

  

 Diagnose and resolve integration issues using structured logs, message traces, and failure\-mode analysis.
   

  

 Create AI\-native operational experiences such as conversational root\-cause analysis, runbook\-guided remediation, and impact analysis—bounded by role\-based access and approval workflows.
   

  

* Integration Strategy \& Maturity Enablement


 Apply integration advisory practices to design hybrid integration platforms and define integration best practices across teams.
   

  

 Use integration assessment approaches to improve integration maturity, standardize patterns, and automate repeatable architectural governance where feasible.
   

  

**Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)**
 Strong hands\-on expertise with SAP BTP Integration Suite concepts and building blocks (cloud integration/iFlows, transformation patterns, monitoring).
   

  

 Proven ability to implement message mappings, routing patterns, and transformation logic across enterprise data formats.
   

  

 Practical scripting capability (e.g., Groovy) for advanced integration flow customization and performance tuning.
   

  

 Solid API design and management fundamentals (security, throttling, lifecycle/versioning, observability).
   

  

 AI\-native delivery capability: tool\-augmented workflows, retrieval\-grounded outputs, measurable evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries.
   

  

 Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
   

  

 Event\-driven integration design and enterprise messaging patterns.
   

  

 Connector\-based integrations with third\-party SaaS ecosystems.
   

  

 Migration and modernization experience from legacy integration platforms to cloud integration.
   

  

 Integration governance and advisory methodologies for enterprise\-wide standardization.
   

  

 What This Role Does Not Center On
   

  

 Training or fine\-tuning foundation models from scratch.
   

  

 AI\-assisted only integration work this role builds and owns AI behavior in the integration layer (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability).
   

  

 Value Delivered
   

  

 Faster integration delivery via intelligent flow generation, mapping recommendations, and script optimization.
   

  

 Higher reliability and lower run cost via anomaly detection, predictive operations, and grounded troubleshooting.
   

  

 Scalable integration landscapes through standardized patterns, governance, and maturity enablement.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 A 15 years full time education is required

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
 Hunch is a dating app built for follow\-through \- designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back\-and\-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
   

  

 With 2\.4M\+ daters, 1\.47M\+ dates planned, and 100% photo\-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe\-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post\-AI world.
   

  

 Link to our fundraising announcement
   

  

**Key Offerings Of Hunch**
* One Drop a Day: A small, hand\-picked set of photo\-verified profiles arrives daily \- chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place \- no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing \- just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time \- nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.


**About The Role**
 We're on the lookout for a SDE\-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose — and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own backend features end\-to\-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async \& event\-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM\-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual\-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node \+ Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice\-to\-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design \& delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands\-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product\-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.


**Preferred Experience**
* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.

 Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall \- getting two interested people into the same room.
   

  

**What We Hire For \- The ABCs**
 Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:

* Boldness \- Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity \- The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.


**How We Work**
* Ownership, not theater \- You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real \- We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week \- show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out \- Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems \- You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.


**Backed by Global Investors**
 Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
   

  

**Experienced Leadership**
 Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) \- serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer\-tech startup.

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Manifest Global**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans
 **Cialfo** 
 (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools),
 **BridgeU** 
 (university guidance for international schools globally),
 **Kaaiser** 
 (trusted study abroad counseling across India and Southeast Asia), and
 **Explore** 
 (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 What This Role Is
   

 AI agents — systems that reason, plan, take action across tools, and complete real work end\-to\-end — have moved from research demos to production infrastructure in the last eighteen months. The companies that build them well will define the next decade of what software is and what people do.
   

 Manifest Global sits at one of the most operationally complex intersections in the world. Every day, our platforms move students between continents, counselors between conversations, applications between deadlines, universities between recruiting cycles, and agents between thousands of families making generational decisions. The work is high\-stakes, high\-volume, and full of judgment calls — exactly the kind of work that breaks under brittle automation and exactly the kind of work AI agents, built properly, can transform.
   

 That is the bet behind this role. Not chatbots. Not wrappers. Agents that actually do the work — drafting university shortlists with reasoning a counselor would defend, surfacing the right student profile to the right admissions officer, catching the document that's about to make an application fail before a human sees it. Agents that hold context across long workflows. Agents that know when to escalate and when to keep going. Agents that get measurably better as more of the network uses them.
   

 You will build those agents across the Manifest portfolio, in production, at a scale that matters.
   

 What Makes This Role Different
   

 Most companies hiring AI agent builders right now have one of two problems. They have the data but no real product surface to deploy into, so the agents sit in demos waiting for distribution. Or they have the distribution but the underlying data is too fragmented to support agents that work in production. Manifest has both. Cialfo's 2,000\+ schools, BridgeU's international school footprint, Kaaiser's three decades of placement data, Explore's 1,000\+ universities — that is the substrate. Saige, already live inside Cialfo, is proof that AI in this domain works when it is built well. Your job is to extend that surface across the portfolio.
   

 This is not a research role. The agents you build will be used by real counselors, students, admissions officers, and partners within weeks of being shipped, not quarters. The feedback loop is tight. The accountability is direct. If an agent you built makes a bad shortlist, a counselor will tell you the same week. That is the speed at which good AI products get built right now, and it is the speed this role operates at.
   

 The broader EdTech market is contracting. Manifest is growing. AI is the lever — and the people who build the agents will define what the next version of this company looks like.
   

 What You Own
   

**The agent platform**
* Design and build production AI agents across Manifest's brands, starting with the highest\-leverage workflows in counseling, admissions outreach, and operational triage
* Own the architecture decisions: model selection, tool use, memory, evaluation, guardrails, and the orchestration layer that holds it together
* Build the abstractions that turn one good agent into a platform


**Evaluation and reliability**
* Define what "working" means for each agent in measurable terms, and build the evaluation infrastructure that proves it
* Own latency, cost, and accuracy as engineering disciplines, not afterthoughts
* Build the safety layer: when an agent should stop, when it should escalate, when it should ask


**Integration into product**
* Work directly with product and engineering teams across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore to ship agents into the surfaces where users already are
* Translate fuzzy user problems into agent specifications that can actually be built
* Close the loop between user feedback and model behaviour faster than anyone in this industry currently does


**Technical direction**
* Set the standard for how AI agents are built at Manifest — tooling, frameworks, model providers, evaluation harness, deployment patterns
* Stay close enough to the research frontier to know what is becoming possible six months out, and ship accordingly


 What Success Looks Like
   

* The markers below reflect where Manifest's AI agent function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
* In the first weeks, you have a clear point of view on which workflows across the portfolio are the highest\-leverage places to deploy agents — and you can defend that view to the counselors, product leaders, and engineers who will use what you build. You have started building, not just planning. Something is in the hands of a real user by the end of month three.
* By mid\-period, at least one agent you have built is in production, used daily, and measurably better than the manual workflow it replaced. The evaluation infrastructure exists and is trusted by the people whose work depends on it. Other engineers across the group know how to build agents the Manifest way because you have made that pattern legible.
* Longer term, the agent layer is infrastructure, not a project. New product surfaces ship with AI agents as a default, not an exception. The work you built outlasts the specific models you started with, because the architecture you chose absorbed model upgrades without rewriting from scratch. The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.


 What You Bring
   

* You have spent the better part of your career building software that runs in production — and somewhere in the last two years, you became one of the people other engineers go to when they have a hard question about LLMs, agents, or how to actually make this stuff work outside a notebook. You have shipped something agentic. Not a prototype. Something users use.
* You know the current frontier well enough to be opinionated about it. You have working views on which model providers to use for what, which orchestration patterns hold up under real load, where the abstractions in popular agent frameworks leak, and how to evaluate something that doesn't have a single correct answer. You write production\-quality Python. You are comfortable with the surrounding stack: vector stores, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, observability tooling.
* You think in systems, not in prompts. When you see a workflow, you instinctively map where reasoning happens, where state lives, where tools get called, where humans need to stay in the loop. You build for the model that ships in six months, not the one that exists today.
* You are self\-directed in the way this kind of role requires. There is no finished playbook for what you are building. The questions you will face — which agent to build next, how much to invest in evaluation infrastructure, when to use a smaller model and when to use a frontier one — will not have obvious answers. You make calls, you ship, you learn, you adjust.
* Somewhere underneath the technical depth, you care about what the agents you build actually do in the world. The fact that a student in Delhi or Manila or Lagos is going to make a better university decision because of code you wrote — that matters to you.
* Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building in AI and your first reaction was the agents I want to build are exactly the ones this company needs built. That's the person this role is for.


 Why Manifest
   

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 For this role specifically, the AI agents you build are not adjacent to the mission — they are the mission's primary lever. Counselors cannot serve every student who needs guidance. Universities cannot manually reach every qualified applicant. Operations teams cannot manually track every application across every destination. The only way the infrastructure we are building reaches the scale the problem actually demands is through AI agents that hold their own in real work. That is what this seat is for.
   

*Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.*

 how we build as the team grows.

 Own features from API to screen across Flutter, Python and TypeScript. Fix, refactor and extend

 Three to five years at a product company, with at least one consumer app shipped to real
 



 users; payments or marketplace experience is a plus. Working ability in at least two of Flutter,
 



 Python and TypeScript, and the willingness to work in all three. Familiarity with MongoDB, a

 ambiguity: you would rather ship and learn than wait for a spec. Clear communication, since

 Five\-day week, hybrid from our Gurugram office, with flexibility around business needs during

 Fixed salary, competitive for stage and experience.

Actively participate in relevant training and certification programs to maintain technical proficiency

title: Salesforce CPQ engineer 3
description:
Engineer 3, Business Systems (CPQ)
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

**About Team**
 The CRM Technologies Team plays a critical role in optimizing our sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce and Quote\-to\-Cash technologies, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, and operational support needed to effectively manage quoting, pricing, approvals, and downstream business processes.
   

  

 With deep expertise in Salesforce development, CPQ, integrations, and platform operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM ecosystem to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Deal Desk, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Quote\-to\-Cash solutions.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a CPQ Engineer III to design, build, and support core capabilities in our Configure–Price–Quote (CPQ) stack that power how our GTM teams sell and price MongoDB offerings. As a senior individual contributor, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of features across configuration, pricing, discounting, approvals, and quote generation, working closely with Product, Deal Strategy, RevOps, and Sales.
   

  

 You will translate business requirements into high\-quality technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ and related platforms, spanning configuration, custom development (Apex/LWC/Flows), and integrations with downstream systems. This role is hands\-on and delivery\-focused: you will be responsible for implementing well\-structured, testable solutions, improving performance and reliability of existing CPQ flows, and contributing to shared patterns, frameworks, and best practices within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering team.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design, build, and support Salesforce solutions across product modeling, pricing, quoting, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Configure and enhance CPQ capabilities including product rules, price rules, bundles, product options, quote templates, discounting, and approval workflows
* Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Deal Desk to understand requirements, identify process gaps, and deliver scalable business solutions
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and platform APIs to support related processes
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, contract, and other enterprise platforms
* Participate in technical design, story grooming, sprint planning, testing, code reviews, release management, and production deployments
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across CPQ configuration, pricing logic, automation, integrations, and system performance
* Support documentation, UAT, regression testing, and user enablement to improve adoption and platform reliability
* Ensure solutions align with security, data governance, and Salesforce platform best practices
* Leverage AI\-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, GitHub Copilot, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, accuracy, and responsible AI usage


**Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery: Translate complex business strategies into scalable technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ, utilizing a mix of declarative configuration and custom development (Apex, LWC, and Flow)
* System Architecture: Design and implement robust integrations between CPQ and downstream systems (ERP, Billing, Telemetry) to ensure data integrity across the Lead\-to\-Cash lifecycle
* Engineering Excellence: Drive high standards for code quality by implementing testable, modular solutions and contributing to shared frameworks and CI/CD best practices
* Performance Optimization: Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in existing CPQ flows, improving calculator speed and user experience for a global sales force
* Mentorship \& Influence: Lead peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical playbook, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering organization


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6\+ years of Salesforce development experience, including strong hands\-on expertise in the Salesforce platform
* Good understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash processes, sales workflows, and Salesforce best practices
* Hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and REST/SOAP APIs
* Experience with product modeling, pricing rules, quoting workflows, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, or other enterprise platforms
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, version control, and Salesforce release practices
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, and implementation best practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist and Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certifications required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Working knowledge of Salesforce Billing and its underlying data model
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Copado, Gearset, Git\-based workflows, or similar DevOps tooling
* Familiarity with Visualforce, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS
* Experience preparing training materials, supporting UAT/regression testing, and guiding business users through solution adoption
* Practical familiarity with AI\-powered and agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them thoughtfully to improve delivery speed, analysis, documentation quality, and engineering effectiveness


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s CPQ implementation, product and pricing structure, Quote\-to\-Cash flows, and stakeholder processes.
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver meaningful enhancements across Salesforce CPQ, support key pricing and quoting workflows, and become a dependable contributor to ongoing QTC initiatives.
* In 12 months, you will: Become a trusted technical SME for Salesforce CPQ and related Quote\-to\-Cash processes, helping drive scalable improvements across pricing, approvals, renewals, amendments, and downstream integrations.


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
