title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the \#1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
   

  

 To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
   

  

 As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production\-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on\-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 What you’ll do at MongoDB
   

  

 In this role, you will
   

  

* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB\-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production\-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes\-based private clouds, and self\-managed or restricted on\-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements


 As an ideal candidate, you will have
   

  

* 5\+ years of hands\-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application\-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application\-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction\-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual\-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C\#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self\-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi\-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade\-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on\-site with ISV partners and travel within the region


 As an ideal candidate, you may also have
   

  

* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward\-deployed, embedded, resident\-engineer, or partner\-engineering role
* Familiarity with event\-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production\-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio


 What you will learn
   

  

* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud\-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data\-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

* Startup by IIT Grads Helps Indian Homes Run on Zero Electricity, Earns Rs 200 Crore in Revenues
* The Climate Conversations ft Solar Square
* Elevation Capital \- SolarSquare


**What This Role Is**
 You are an engineer who leads projects at the scope of a service or major subsystem.
   

  

 That means: when a problem lands on your desk, it's usually ambiguous. Your job is to turn it into a clear problem statement, design a system to solve it, ship it through to production, and own how it behaves once it's there. You'll work with one or two engineers on most projects, and you'll be the technical person product, ops, and other engineering teams talk to about that domain.
   

  

 You're not a senior individual contributor who only writes code for assigned tickets. You're not a tech lead who's stopped writing code. You're the person between those two — still hands\-on, but increasingly the one shaping what gets built.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Solve 2–4 complex problems a year end\-to\-end: shape the problem, design the system, ship it, monitor it.
* Design single\-service systems independently. Define API contracts, data models, scale and reliability requirements. Document and review your design with peers before building.
* Turn ambiguity into clarity. Take half\-formed product tasks and partner with PMs to define what's actually being built. Push back when the ask doesn't make sense.
* Stay hands\-on. Write code that goes into production. Drive code reviews. Debug across service boundaries. Refactor when the codebase needs it.
* Mentor 1–2 junior engineers. Be someone's first reviewer. Pair when it helps. Take their growth as your responsibility, not a side activity.
* Be in hiring. Interview candidates regularly. Help shape the interview bar for your function.
* Own outcomes, not output. Track the business or operational metric your work moves. If it doesn't move, that's a problem you own — not a problem you delivered to.


**What We're Looking For**
* Over 4 years of professional experience in software development, specifically focused on solving large\-scale technical challenges.
* Expert\-level proficiency in at least one major programming language (such as Java, GO, Rust, NodeJS etc) with a focus on writing scalable, maintainable, and unit\-tested code.
* Strong command of object\-oriented design, design patterns, and the creation of intuitive class\-level interfaces.
* Hands\-on experience with multi\-threading, concurrency, and Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* Deep understanding of relational databases (Postgres) and various NoSQL technologies like HBase, Elasticsearch, or Aerospike, Cassandra
* Comprehensive knowledge of the full software development life cycle on Linux platforms.
* Proven ability to build highly scalable applications that manage complex business logic and massive datasets.
* A proactive, "go\-getter" mindset characterized by high energy and dedication to task ownership.
* Experience thriving in fast\-paced startup environments with a strong sense of commitment and accountability.
* A passionate drive to tackle complex, real\-world problems through innovative engineering.
* You've made and defended technical decisions, picked up problems no one assigned, or built things people use that no one asked for.
* Strong fundamentals in your primary stack — concurrency, data modeling, debugging across systems, performance work. We're stack\-agnostic for the right person.
* Experience designing systems with explicit attention to scale, reliability, and cost — not just functional correctness.
* Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to monitor project outcomes and iteratively refine features based on real\-world impact.


 Skills:\- Java, Go Programming (Golang), Rust and NodeJS (Node.js)

 • What problems did you face?

 • What did you learn?

 Learning Ability

 Curiosity
 



 Do you explore technology beyond your college curriculum?
 



  





 Ownership
 



 Can you take responsibility for completing something?
 



  





 Execution
 



 Do you actually build things rather than only completing courses and certifications?
 



  





 Communication
 



 Can you clearly explain what you have built and how it works?

 • Data \& Analytics
 



 • Data Engineering
 



 • Full Stack / MERN
 



 • Python / Backend Engineering
 



 • Cloud \& DevOps
 



 • Automation \& Integrations
 



  





 You do not need to decide your entire technology career before joining.

**Purpose of the role**

Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
   

  

**Accountabilities**

Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Partner with other functions and business areas.

* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.

* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Engineer, Software Engineering
description:
**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**





 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently \#1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009\. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 
 




  






**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**






 Coro is Bain’s persistent product development and engineering organization serving the firm’s digital solutions across Commercial Excellence (B2B) and the newly established Demand Generation Suite (B2C). Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.
 





 This role sits within the newly established B2C pillar of Coro, building the technical foundation for Artemis – Bain’s AI\-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform, and one of three products in the Demand Generation Suite.
 




  






**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM** 






 The Software Engineer role is a full stack engineering position focused on building and maintaining product features across the Artemis backend (Python/FastAPI) and frontend (React/TypeScript). Engineers in this role contribute to platform capabilities used by consultants and clients in live engagements, working within established patterns and with guidance from senior team members. Contributions span both the API layer and the React components that surface those capabilities to users — including the marketing mix model configuration interface, channel allocation dashboards, scenario planning tools, and client\-ready output views.
 





 This is a delivery\-focused role for engineers who are ready to contribute meaningfully across the full stack and grow their ownership over time. The core expectation is shipping well\-tested features within defined specifications, collaborating closely with senior engineers, and developing the habits and judgment that come with working in a production product environment. Additional responsibilities include participating in support and operations by identifying system defects, contributing to troubleshooting efforts, and supporting code deployments.
 




  






**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 





 Feature Development
 
* Implement features across backend API logic and React frontend components for assigned Artemis product areas, working from clear specifications and with guidance from senior engineers. Contribute to taking features from development through testing and deployment across both layers.
* Build and maintain backend routes for assigned product areas, following established patterns for request/response contracts, versioning, and testing. Keep TypeScript type contracts on the frontend in sync with backend changes.



 Frontend and Data Visualization 
 
* Build and maintain React components using the shared Demand Generation Suite design system, contributing to marketing analytics interfaces including channel allocation dashboards, scenario comparison views, and model configuration workflows. Follow established component and styling conventions.
* Write database queries and data access logic for Artemis data models, following existing schema and migration patterns. Develop familiarity with the data volumes and access patterns typical of marketing analytics engagements.



 Quality and Collaboration
 
* Write and maintain tests for backend and frontend code. Ensure new features ship with adequate coverage and do not degrade existing functionality, with support from senior engineers on testing strategy.
* Participate in structured feedback sessions with Artemis Expert Consultants and go\-to\-market\-aligned specialists. Contribute observations and help translate feedback into concrete improvements in subsequent sprints.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across the team and with adjacent stakeholders.



 Innovation \& Emerging Technologies
 
* Drive innovation through out\-of\-the\-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands.
* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs.
* Investigate and keep up\-to\-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing.
* Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches.



  






**ABOUT YOU** 





 Technical
 
* Proficient in Python for backend development, with exposure to or interest in async frameworks (FastAPI or equivalent). Able to implement features within an established codebase and framework.
* Proficient in React and TypeScript in a production or near\-production context, with foundational understanding of state management patterns, data fetching, and TypeScript type safety.
* Familiarity with CSS and comfort working within component libraries and design systems, following established conventions rather than authoring them from scratch.
* Working knowledge of relational databases: writing SQL queries, reading and modifying schemas, and debugging query issues.
* Exposure to data visualization libraries for building chart\-based interfaces is a plus.
* Experience contributing to time and cost estimates of product enhancements, advise on trade\-offs of features.
* Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to support and accelerate development workflows.
* Results\-driven, with an analytical and collaborative mindset. Eager to learn and grow in a fast\-paced Agile environment.



 Education
 
* Associate/Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.



 Experience
 
* 2\-3\+ years of experience building full\-stack web applications.


* Track record of delivering in an Agile environment.
* Experience with troubleshooting and issue resolution skills.
* Experience building web interfaces for data\-heavy or analytics applications, where outputs are used by business users to make commercial decisions, highly preferred.
* Exposure to marketing, media, or commercial data (such as spend, sales, or campaign performance) in any context, including academic or side projects, is a plus.

title: ServiceNow ITSM Techno-Functional Consultant
description:

 To support the Service Automation team within Siemens Energy's Digital Core, this role is established to backfill capacity and address the increased workload from expanded responsibilities and upcoming strategic Energy Now initiatives. Operating at the Experienced Professional (P2\) level in India, the consultant will ensure operational stability, service excellence, and successful execution across key service areas. To address these business aims, the role focuses on ServiceNow ITSM solution design, platform configuration, and stakeholder collaboration. These core areas ensure alignment between business processes and technical implementations while driving out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) adoption and minimizing platform customizations.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**

+ Design and deliver scalable, upgrade\-safe solutions across ServiceNow ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management) leveraging out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) capabilities.
+ Configure core platform architecture, including Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, custom scripting, and third\-party tool integrations (e.g., Snowflake, Jira, Salesforce).
+ Implement and manage technical integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, and Import Sets, ensuring alignment with platform security models and ACLs.
+ Promote OOTB adoption, minimize unnecessary customizations, and leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities to deliver efficient solutions.

* Functional Consulting \& Stakeholder Management
+ Conduct discovery workshops and sessions with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate requirements into functional specifications.
+ Prepare comprehensive design documents and define acceptance criteria to guide technical teams and review final solution designs.
+ Provide strategic recommendations on ServiceNow best practices, process optimization, and alignment with CMDB, CSDM, and SPM modules.

* Project Delivery \& Operational Support
+ Collaborate within Agile/Scrum and SAFe delivery environments to support the execution of strategic EnergyNow projects and initiatives.
+ Perform acceptance testing, validate solutions against requirements, and coordinate deployment activities with delivery partners to ensure operational stability.


**What You Bring**
* 6 to 8 years of professional experience in ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS\-ITSM).
* ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting experience.
* ServiceNow Core Architecture \& Administration.
* Flow Designer \& IntegrationHub Configuration.
* ServiceNow Scripting \& Customization Best Practices.
* Integration Technologies (REST, SOAP, MID Server, Import Sets).
* IT Service Management (ITSM) Process Design.
* Common Service Data Model (CSDM) \& CMDB.
* Requirement Gathering \& Business Systems Analysis.
* Solution Architecture \& Design Documentation.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication.
* Agile/Scrum \& SAFe Methodologies.
* Analytical Problem\-Solving.


**About The Team**
 Our Corporate and Global Functions play a critical role in driving Siemens Energy’s strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across departments, business areas, and regions. As part of this team, you will contribute to shaping the global energy transition, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and conduct business responsibly while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. description:

 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

 Drive the delivery and continuous improvement of robust, scalable contact center solutions by managing escalations, integrating advanced technologies, and optimizing omnichannel interactions to support seamless customer experiences across Orange’s platform ecosystem.
   

  

* Troubleshoot and resolve escalated incidents related to IVR, call routing, SIP trunks, and omnichannel interactions.

* Develop and maintain APIs, webhooks, and system integrations to enhance automation and scalability.
* Implement AI\-powered chatbots, speech analytics, and automation solutions to drive efficiency.

**About You**
 You bring over 5 years of experience in Contact Center Engineering, including a minimum of 3 years with hands\-on work in Genesys Cloud CX. You possess deep technical knowledge in ACD, IVR, SIP, WebRTC, and omnichannel functionality, along with experience in scripting and API integrations. You are proficient with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and adept at integrating contact center solutions with CRM systems. Your background includes workforce engagement management and AI\-driven technologies, and you hold relevant certifications such as Genesys Cloud CX/NICE CXone CIP Core.
   

  

**Your professional skills:**
* Demonstrate extensive experience with Genesys Cloud CX and contact center engineering spanning more than 5 years.

* Integrate contact center platforms with CRM software including Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Microsoft Dynamics to enhance customer data flow.
* Employ hands\-on experience with Architects, Composer, and Interaction Routing tools within contact center environments.

* Effectively address and resolve complex technical problems with clear troubleshooting strategies.
* Communicate complex concepts and technical information clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders.
* Adapt to evolving technologies and dynamic project requirements with flexibility and continuous learning.

Experience an environment that values skill development, adaptability, and continuous improvement, aligned with Orange’s mission to connect and empower communities.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About Us:** 




 We are a profitable health\-tech brand focusing on men's sexual wellness, scaling our revenue target from 5 cr to 40 cr this year. We have cracked Product\-Market Fit and are now rebuilding our core engine to handle an 8x traffic multiplier. Because of our niche, user data is highly sensitive.
 



  





**\[Expected Compensation Range: ₹35,00,000 – ₹55,00,000 per annum]** 




  





**The Role:** 




 The Permanent Player\-Coach We do not want an Engineering Manager who only manages Jira boards, nor do we want a lone\-wolf architect. This is a hands\-on Engineering Manager role. We expect a 60/40 split: you will spend the majority of your time writing the hardest architectural code and the remaining managing the humans writing the rest.
 



  





**Experience Range:** 




 8 to 12 years of backend development, with proven architectural responsibilities, system design and team management experience.
 



  





**The 6\-Month Trajectory:** 




 ● 
 **Months 1\-2 (Heavy Architecture):** 
 Your focus will be architecting the AWS\-to\-Zoho pipelines and queues, getting your hands dirty in the codebase, and earning the technical respect of the current team.
 



 ●
 **Months 3\-6\+ (The Steady State):** 
 You will take full ownership of the tech org and begin exploring the manager side of the role.
 



 You will be building critical features and running the Weekly Triage, conducting 1\-on\-1s, and partnering with the existing Tech Lead to optimize sprint delivery.
 



 You’ll begin representing the engineering function at the org level and with various internal/external stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ● Architect the Core (The "Player"): Design and build the resilient integration layer between our systems and the Zoho ecosystem.
 



 ● Lead the Team (The "Coach"): Partner with our existing Technical Lead (who will act as your elite Delivery Lead). Run the Weekly Triage, enforce strict Kanban flow, and protect the team from scope creep.
 



 ● Own System Security: Ensure secure API design, implementing data encryption, payload masking, and strict access controls to prevent data breaches of highly sensitive patient histories.
 



 ● Manage Technical Debt: Establish proper coding standards and automated testing thresholds without bringing feature velocity to a halt.
 



 ● Mentorship: Upskill a team of 5\-6 junior developers with the empathy and patience to turn them into enterprise\-grade engineers.
 



 ● Pair With The Product Management Function: Partner with the product management function to streamline the roadmap.
 



 ● Stakeholder Management: Be the face of the engineering organization for internal/external stakeholders.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 ● 8 to 12 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of managing at least one small team through a rapid scaling phase (the "1 to 10" journey).
 



 ● Senior\-level proficiency in backend architecture (Node.js) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL). Frontend experience, while not mandatory, will be a BIG plus.\*
 



 ● Deep, practical, hands\-on experience designing and managing message queues and asynchronous background jobs.
 



 ● Experience integrating complex third\-party enterprise suites (specifically CRMs) and handling massive traffic spikes.
 



 ● High empathy and low ego; you must know how to partner with an existing, hard\-working startup team rather than dictating changes on day one.
 



 ● Working knowledge of DevOps workflows on any of the public clouds (AWS\*, GCP, Azure)

title: Platform Engineer - OpenStack
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cloudstrats is an Indian exponential technology product company that builds Artificial Intelligence platforms powered by analytics and automation. Its solutions use computer vision, speech, and text technologies to address complex real\-world challenges for government and enterprise customers. The company’s platforms apply Deep Learning, NLP, and ML to support sustainable development goals across sectors such as citizen services, public safety, education, health, and transport. Cloudstrats delivers marquee projects including command control centers, e\-governance solutions, grievance redressal platforms, data hubs, fraud detection, and health systems. The organization is driven by the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and large\-scale digital transformation in India and beyond.
 



  





***Immediate Joiners preferred.***




  





**About the Role.** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on private\-cloud engineer who can take an OpenStack\-based platform from bare metal to a working, accepted, and supportable production environment — and then own it through its operational lifecycle.
 



 This is a greenfield deployment covering compute, software\-defined storage, GPU enablement, Kubernetes, and an AI/ML platform. You'll lead or contribute to technical delivery, automation, capacity growth, operational improvement, resilience testing, documentation, and training of the internal cloud team.
 



 This is not a role for someone who has only consumed OpenStack through a dashboard. We need someone who has deployed it, broken it, recovered it, automated it, and documented it — using Kolla Ansible as the deployment tooling.
 



 The role combines architecture input with hands\-on engineering. You won't be expected to single\-handedly deliver every specialist subsystem without support, but you must understand the full platform and be able to troubleshoot across its major layers.
 



  





**What You will do.** 




 Deployment \& Architecture
 


* Design and deploy a multi\-node OpenStack private cloud using Kolla Ansible
* Configure a highly available control plane and define service placement, failure domains, and network segmentation (management, API, provider, tenant, external)
* Deploy and configure core services: Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Maintain version\-controlled inventory, configuration, and secrets\-management procedures
* Produce architecture documents, capacity plans, and implementation runbooks



 Storage
 


* Design and deploy a distributed software\-defined storage platform (Ceph preferred) as the shared substrate
* Integrate block/image storage with Glance, Cinder, and Nova; stand up an S3\-compatible object endpoint
* Define replication/erasure\-coding policies, failure domains, and capacity thresholds
* Validate failure, degraded\-mode, and recovery behaviour



 Networking \& Security
 


* Design and configure management, API, provider, tenant, storage, and tunnel networks
* Implement VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, and security groups per the organisation's addressing standards
* Apply security\-hardening baselines and maintain compliance evidence



 Compute \& Workloads
 


* Build and maintain golden images and flavour catalogues (CPU, memory, NUMA, huge pages, GPU profiles)
* Configure host aggregates, availability zones, and placement/scheduling policies
* Restore and re\-platform existing Windows and Linux workloads into the new environment



 GPU Enablement
 


* Enable GPU access end\-to\-end: firmware, BIOS, IOMMU, kernel parameters, drivers, device binding
* Configure PCI passthrough or vGPU as required; configure Nova PCI aliases, traits, and scheduler filters
* Expose GPU resources to Kubernetes worker nodes via appropriate device plugins



 Kubernetes \& AI/ML Platform
 


* Deploy and operate a highly available Kubernetes cluster on the private cloud
* Configure CNI, ingress, RBAC, CSI\-backed persistent storage, and GPU\-schedulable nodes
* Deploy an approved AI/ML workspace platform (notebooks, training jobs, model serving) with per\-project isolation and quotas



 Identity \& Enterprise Integration
 


* Integrate with the organisation's enterprise directory; configure SSO/federation across OpenStack, Kubernetes, and the AI workspace
* Implement role mapping, least\-privilege access, and credential\-rotation procedures



 Monitoring, Logging \& Audit
 


* Implement monitoring/alerting across hosts, OpenStack services, storage, VMs, Kubernetes, and GPU utilisation
* Configure centralised logging, audit collection, and alert escalation



 Resilience, Backup \& Recovery
 


* Define and execute resilience tests (compute/controller/storage/network/Kubernetes/GPU/identity failure scenarios)
* Validate backup/restore against agreed RTO/RPO targets
* Produce test plans, execution evidence, and resilience reports



 Restricted\-Network Delivery
 


* Build and maintain internal package repositories and private container registries
* Prepare an offline bill of materials (packages, images, charts, drivers, firmware, licenses)
* Establish controlled import, scanning, signing, and promotion procedures
* Ensure deployment, patching, and recovery can operate without dependency on public internet access



 Lifecycle Ownership
 *(post go\-live)* 



* Own technical evolution: capacity expansion, tuning, upgrades, automation
* Act as escalation point for platform issues; lead root\-cause analysis
* Maintain architecture documents, SOPs, and runbooks
* Train the internal cloud engineering team to independent competency



  





**Experience we Need.** 




  





 Core
 


* 6\+ years infrastructure/platform\-engineering experience; 3\+ years hands\-on OpenStack
* Demonstrable delivery of at least one production OpenStack environment from install through acceptance
* Evidence of personal technical contribution, not just project oversight



  





 OpenStack \& Kolla Ansible
 


* Strong working knowledge of Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Hands\-on Kolla Ansible: inventory, globals config, secrets handling, bootstrap, prechecks, deployment, validation, upgrades
* Ability to troubleshoot containerised OpenStack services and deployment failures



  





 Storage
 


* Hands\-on experience with a distributed SDS platform (Ceph preferred)
* Experience integrating storage with Glance/Cinder/Nova and Kubernetes CSI



  





 Linux, Compute \& Networking
 


* Deep Linux systems engineering (kernel, drivers, systemd, networking, storage stacks)
* Strong KVM/QEMU understanding
* VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, DNS, NTP, load balancing



  





 Kubernetes \& AI Platforms
 


* Production Kubernetes deployment and operation experience
* GPU scheduling via vendor device plugins
* AI/ML platform deployment (notebooks, training, model serving) strongly preferred



  





 GPU Virtualisation
 


* PCI/IOMMU passthrough, device binding, driver installation and validation in VMs/containers



  





 Identity, Observability \& Automation
 


* Enterprise directory integration, SSO/RBAC, certificate and secrets management
* Strong Python/shell scripting and Ansible or equivalent IaC experience



  





 Restricted\-Network Environments
 


* Demonstrable experience delivering in air\-gapped or restricted\-network environments
* Comfortable with formal change control, security review, and audit evidence



  





**Desirable.** 



* Ceph RBD, CephFS, RADOS Gateway
* Octavia, Barbican, Ironic, Heat, Swift, Manila
* Kubeflow, JupyterHub, MLflow, Ray, KServe, vLLM, or comparable AI/ML platforms
* NVIDIA GPU operators or equivalent vendor tooling
* Multi\-site disaster recovery experience
* CKA / CKS / Linux / OpenStack certifications (supplementary to delivery evidence, not a substitute



  





**You will own.** 




 High\-level and low\-level architecture · Capacity\-sizing workbook · Kolla Ansible configuration · IP/VLAN/DNS/firewall matrix · Storage architecture and recovery procedures · GPU enablement report · Kubernetes and AI\-platform architecture · Restricted\-network BOM · Security baseline · Monitoring/logging catalogue · Backup/RTO/RPO design · Migration and cutover plan · Resilience test plan and evidence · As\-built documentation · Runbooks and SOPs · Training materials
